shortDescription: BNP Paribas downgraded Micron Technology NASDAQ:MU to Neutral from Outperform due in part to potential data center capacity delays and memory content reductions.The financial services firm also slashed its price target to $775 from $1,700."Yes, Micron's shares have fallen 42% from its peak in June…

children: to Neutral from Outperform due in part to potential data center capacity delays and memory content reductions.
The financial services firm also slashed its price target to $775 from $1,700.

"Yes, Micron's shares have fallen 42% from its peak in June, but growing risks to hyperscaler capacity plans in 2028 further threaten S/D fundamentals while HBM content is being reduced in Vera Rubin Ultra, PC and mobile units will decline in ’26 and ’27, and incremental wafer capacity comes online," said BNP analyst Karl Ackerman in a Tuesday note.

"We think the downside risk to an oversupply scenario is mounting with growing risks of data center permit delays to 2028 data center capacity, content reductions in AI servers, PC, and mobile, and accelerated memory capacity by memory producers," he added. "We think DRAM and NAND supply-demand can approach parity starting in mid-2027 and result in ASP declines, earlier than our prior view of mid-2028."
BNP now believes that memory and storage costs related to AI spending will peak at 40% in 2027 and decline to 27% by calendar year 2030.
Micron had tumbled nearly 12% during afternoon trading on Tuesday.

title: Micron downgraded to Neutral over data center risks, memory reductions: BNP
